title: 36 Hours in Syracuse, Sicily
abstract: Architecture that spans centuries, troves of religious art, a distinctive sweet-savory cuisine and glorious Mediterranean sunsets: This ancient city is filled with timeless riches.

title: 36 Hours in Geneva
abstract: At once deeply Swiss and intrinsically international, this city on the shores of Lake Geneva has carved out its own place in the world.

title: 36 Hours in Albuquerque
abstract: In this New Mexico city, fall is a colorful affair, with the yearly Balloon Fiesta, flamenco, Pueblo culture and forest hikes.

title: 36 Hours in Dublin
abstract: A vibrant culture of Irish food, crafts, booze, literature and music offers a weekend of diversions, but it’s Dublin’s complex history and its welcoming spirit that will linger longest.
